Each puzzle instance has a task id and a test input grid. Tasks recur across the
stream with fresh inputs. Each instance is a separate conversation: the next one
starts without this one's messages.

instance is over when a submission is correct or when the attempt cap is reached, and
reaching the cap is charged the full cap. Feedback on a submission is only
correct/incorrect. There is no way to abandon an instance, and finish is refused until

from collections import deque
H=W=20;k=4
valid={(r,c) for r in range(H-k+1) for c in range(W-k+1) if all(grid[i][j]!=3 for i in range(r,r+k) for j in range(c,c+k))}
start=(11,1)
print('start valid?', start in valid, 'count',len(valid))
adj=lambda p:[(p[0]+dr,p[1]+dc) for dr,dc in [(1,0),(-1,0),(0,1),(0,-1)] if (p[0]+dr,p[1]+dc) in valid]
seen={start};q=deque([start])
while q:
 p=q.popleft()
 for n in adj(p):
  if n not in seen:seen.add(n);q.append(n)
terms=[p for p in seen if not adj(p)]
print(len(seen), sorted(terms))
print('reachable target positions with 2', sorted(p for p in seen if any(grid[i][j]==2 for i in range(p[0],p[0]+k) for j in range(p[1],p[1]+k))))
